en.t_1mzpokfpdo659: Upper eyelid rejuvenation — removing excess skin for a natural, refreshed expression.
en.t_6t5o4v1nu8bfl: Heavy upper eyelids affect far more than your appearance — they can narrow your field of vision and make you look tired. Upper blepharoplasty removes excess skin and corrects age-related blepharochalasis and ptosis, restoring a natural, refreshed expression while preserving eyelid function.
en.t_0ngcor0dv4ozu: Lower eyelid rejuvenation that smooths bags and restores a youthful contour.
en.t_0ywsqhb9txnhp: Lower eyelid blepharoplasty addresses under-eye bags and laxity, smoothing the lower lid contour for a rested, youthful look while protecting eyelid function.
en.t_579x211q4qx5b: Correction of age-related blepharochalasis and ptosis for open, natural-looking eyes.
en.t_e6wv8h1mn4i15: Eyelid margin reconstruction and symmetry restoration repair the delicate structure of the eyelid, combining functional protection of the eye with a harmonious, natural appearance.
en.t_1pkbd8s1aeemv5: Excision of xanthelasma, retention cysts and eyelid papillomas.
en.t_753u021rric4g: Minor periocular surgery removes xanthelasma, retention cysts and eyelid papillomas with careful technique, preserving eyelid health and leaving a clean, natural result.
en.t_0h3v8e7xshzm1: Pterygium removal with conjunctival autografting for a clear, healthy eye.
en.t_1exx75br3bvxy: Pterygium removal with conjunctival autografting clears the eye surface and reduces the chance of recurrence, restoring comfort and a healthy appearance.
en.t_zlw9fs1dz2g2t: Modern phacoemulsification with intraocular lens (IOL) implantation.
en.t_1dsovb2k4dft6: State-of-the-art phacoemulsification removes the clouded lens through a tiny incision and replaces it with an intraocular lens (IOL), restoring clear vision with fast recovery.
en.t_0cv7nmq1tfneu: Diagnosis and long-term management of glaucoma to protect your sight.
en.t_1f8pnl73vgeyk: Drawing on her Ph.D. research into the genetic and biomolecular mechanisms of primary open-angle glaucoma, Dr. Dina provides precise diagnosis, laser therapies and long-term care to protect your sight.
en.t_2ihdo51us0i8f: Optical coherence tomography for precise diagnosis of retina and glaucoma.
en.t_o23ib81spl9kl: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) provides detailed, non-invasive imaging of the retina and optic nerve — essential for precise diagnosis of glaucoma and retinal disease.
en.t_1flcoec5iqbn9: Gentle surgical correction and alignment for children's ocular motility disorders.
en.t_0jhmeibaodave: We welcome young patients with patience and care. Pediatric strabismus is managed through gentle surgical correction and therapeutic alignment for healthy visual development.
en.t_01v8tvkzsl9kb: Surgical correction and therapeutic alignment for adult strabismus.
en.t_0uqeqlhbyorr9: Strabismus in adults affects both vision and appearance. Through surgical correction and therapeutic alignment, Dr. Dina restores balanced eye position and comfortable binocular vision.
en.t_0v50tda663njj: Laser iridectomy to manage and prevent angle-closure glaucoma.
en.t_ewrabj18o41z6: Laser iridectomy is a quick, precise laser procedure that improves fluid drainage inside the eye, helping to manage and prevent angle-closure glaucoma.
en.t_0j8y6463mctav: Selective retinal laser photocoagulation to protect your vision.
en.t_15enlt3lultwa: Selective retinal laser photocoagulation treats retinal disease precisely, helping to preserve sight with a minimally invasive approach.
en.t_0h6k0ivhqbeed: Comprehensive eye examination to protect your vision for life.
en.t_0ppjq7zp27cm1: A comprehensive eye examination with modern diagnostics is the foundation of every treatment — so problems are found early and your vision stays protected for years.
